body: > ℹ️ No critical issues — one visual rough edge inline. **Reviewed changes** This review covers the whole PR: "Your video is ready" moves out of the main window's status stack into its own floating window, built on the capture toast's pattern. - **Floating window manager**: `RecordingReadyWindow` creates the window and shows it with `showInactive`. It reuses the window for each new take, sizes it to the height the card reports, and turns each action into a typed hand-off to the main window. - **Take display tracking**: `RecordingHubHandle.lastTakeDisplayId()` records the display of the area, the countdown or the screen source. The window opens there, or on the cursor's display when that is unknown. - **IPC contract**: `shared/types/recording-ready.ts` defines the payload, actions and hand-offs, with parsers for everything that crosses IPC. It adds six `recording-ready:*` channels. - **Renderer entry and hand-offs**: the `?window=recording-ready` root renders the same `PostRecordingCard`. `useRecordingReadyHandOffs` turns each hand-off into a route using `preparePath`, `editorPathFor` and the library detail route. - **Ask-then-fallback on the recording page**: `useFloatingReadyCard` asks main once per `location.key`, after the probe settles. The in-app card shows only when main answers `false` or the IPC rejects. - **`PostRecordingCard`**: adds an optional `onOpen` prop and an `openFloatingHint` string in English and Spanish.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/4?action=fix&review_id=5730240971) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/4?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730240971) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/actions/runs/41349385331/job/124976065150) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
